title: A prime isoartinian ring that is not noetherian
summary: A right module is isoartinian (resp., isonoetherian) if every descending (resp., ascending) chain of submodules is eventually constant up to isomorphism, and a ring R is right isoartinian (resp., isonoethe- rian) if RR is isoartinian (resp., isonoetherian). Facchini and Nazemian proved that a semiprime right isoartinian ring is right noetherian if and only if it is right isonoetherian if and only if it has finite Goldie dimen- sion and that every commutative semiprime isoartinian ring is noether- ian.
